description: This file is a React component for a calendar page in a LMS (Learning Management System). It includes features like viewing events in month/week/agenda modes, fetching and managing calendar events, modals for creating meetings and reminders, and detailed event views with editing capabilities.

classes.name: CalendarEvent
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of a calendar event, including properties like id, title, date, type, status, and optional fields like course details and meeting link.

methods.name: CalendarPage
methods.description: Main React component rendering the calendar dashboard, managing state for current view, events, modals, and user interactions.

methods.name: EventDetailModal
methods.description: Component for viewing and editing details of a selected calendar event, supporting modes for display or editing.

methods.name: CreateMeetingModal
methods.description: Modal component allowing users with appropriate roles to create a new meeting or live class event.

methods.name: AddReminderModal
methods.description: Modal component for adding a simple reminder event to the calendar.
